question: Which of the following performance categories belongs to Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra and Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Yuva Prativa Sunman?
solution:
The correct answer is **Odissi dance and music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a legendary exponent of the Odissi dance form.
 
• He is credited with reviving and popularizing **Odissi dance** on the global stage.
 
• The **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Yuva Prativa Sunman** is an award given to young talents in the field of Odissi dance and music.
 
• This award aims to recognize and encourage the contributions of young artists in preserving the legacy of **Odissi dance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Category
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Odissi Dance
 **Odissi** is one of the classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
 

 Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra
 **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra** was an iconic figure in the Odissi dance community and a recipient of numerous awards for his contributions.
 
 

 Yuva Prativa Sunman
 The **Yuva Prativa Sunman** is an award that honors young talents in Odissi dance and music, promoting the art form among the new generation.
